[SWS_DM_01032] Handling of ’WIR’ bit without connected indicators
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If there exists no
DiagnosticConnectedIndicator
configuration item for a
Di-
agnosticEvent
and therefore no indicators are assigned to an event and the status
for this event gets confirmed, the DM shall always keep the
UDS DTC status bit
"
kWarningIndicatorRequested
" at value ’0’.
⌋
The DM process the indicator healing based on the
DiagnosticConnectedIndi-
cator.healingCycleCounterThreshold
configuration parameter of the corre-
sponding indicator assigned to an event via
DiagnosticConnectedIndicator.
indicator
.
